task_prompt: Insert the stirring rod into the mug and stir the liquid.
task_summary: The left hand steadies and lifts a glass mug while the right hand inserts a green stirring rod, makes repeated circular strokes, and withdraws it.

objects.name: green stirring rod
properties: Slender shape-preserving rod held at its upper end.
Its lower tip must enter the liquid inside the mug.
Stirring requires a repeated path through the liquid, rather than a stationary inserted rod.
objects.evidence: Right hand holds the green rod at 0-12.5 s and moves it inside the mug near 2-8 s.

objects.name: transparent glass mug
properties: Open cylindrical vessel with a handle.
Contains liquid that is stirred by the rod.
Left hand supports the mug while the right hand stirs.
objects.evidence: Left hand lifts the mug near 1-2 s, holds it at 2-11 s and lowers it near 11-12.5 s.

objects.name: liquid
properties: Fluid inside the mug must be contacted and agitated by the rod.
Rod motion should be measured over time, not just at the final frame.
No chemical reaction or quantitative homogeneity is established by the video.
objects.evidence: The interior of the mug is visible while the rod moves in it at 2-8 s.

subgoals.goal: The mug is held in the left hand.

hand_roles.left: Supports the mug near its rim.

subgoals.action: Insert the rod tip into the mug.
subgoals.goal: The stirring rod tip is inside the mug.
The stirring rod tip traces repeated circular strokes through the liquid.

hand_roles.right: Moves the green rod repeatedly around the mug interior.

subgoals.action: Withdraw and hold the stirring rod.
subgoals.goal: The stirring rod is held in the right hand.

hand_roles.right: Lifts the rod tip out of the mug.

subgoals.action: Lower the mug to the table.
subgoals.goal: The mug rests on the table.

task_success: The liquid has been stirred with the stirring rod, the stirring rod is held in the right hand, the mug rests on the table.
